data_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily prices; monthly close-to-close holding returns

methodology.asia_two_slots: Asia 15% sleeve split equally between rank 1 and rank 2 (7.5% each); other equity sleeves 15%; hedge 40%.
methodology.greece_exclusion: EGPT/GREK/TUR versus EGPT/TUR, same 15% fourth sleeve.
methodology.coverage: Strict complete coverage; every comparison uses exact common holding months.
methodology.rolling_windows: 36 and 60 common monthly observations; report distribution of test-minus-baseline metric differences.
methodology.regimes: ACWI trailing 12-month return at signal date: above +5% risk-on, below -5% risk-off, otherwise sideways.
methodology.limitations: Exploratory model, not official Logical Invest replication. No fees, taxes, FX or slippage. Attribution arithmetic is descriptive, not causal or a tradable counterfactual.

market_regimes.definition: ACWI trailing 12-month return measured at the prior month-end signal: >+5% risk_on, <-5% risk_off, otherwise sideways. Because regimes contain non-contiguous months, report conditional monthly statistics only; no CAGR or drawdown is calculated. Descriptive classification, not causal.

candidate_attribution.note: Weighted contribution is sleeve weight multiplied by the ETF's monthly return; cumulative sum is attribution arithmetic, not a standalone tradable portfolio return.
